_readme: Content for the #/royalsquare page. Edit this file to update the page — no code changes needed. Set sampleContent to false once the notices/bills/services/events below are real.
name: Sai Royal Square Apartments
tagline: Home, and everything that keeps it running.

landmarks.name: St. Ann's CBSE School
landmarks.hint: Closest well-known landmark — we're a short way south-west of it.

landmarks.name: 80 Feet Road
landmarks.hint: Main road to the north. Turn onto SBI Colony Road from here.

landmarks.name: SBI Colony Road
landmarks.hint: The road the colony is named after — we're just off it.

landmarks.name: B1 Aqua Sports
landmarks.hint: On SBI Colony Road, useful if you're coming from the west.

landmarks.name: Bakkanapalem Road
landmarks.hint: Runs north from 80 Feet Road, on the western side.

gettingHere: Head for PM Palem (Pothinamallayya Palem) and get onto 80 Feet Road.
Turn into SBI Colony Road — St. Ann's CBSE School is the landmark to aim for.
The building is a short way in, on Street 3. Look for the name board.
If a driver is lost, the Plus Code R85R+WM5 drops a pin exactly on the building.

notices.title: Overhead tank cleaning
notices.body: Water supply will be off between 10am and 2pm while both overhead tanks are cleaned. Please store what you need the night before.

notices.title: Lift AMC service visit
notices.body: The lift will be out of service for roughly two hours in the morning for its quarterly maintenance check.

notices.title: Parking slots re-marked
notices.body: Slot numbers in the basement have been repainted. Please park only in your allotted slot.

events.title: Ganesh Chaturthi
events.body: Pandal in the parking area. Setup from the evening before — volunteers welcome.

events.title: Association meeting
events.body: Quarterly meeting on the terrace. Agenda circulated a week ahead.

events.title: Diwali
events.body: Common area lighting and rangoli. Please keep crackers away from parked vehicles.

events.title: Sankranti
events.body: Muggu competition in the morning, lunch together afterwards.
